title: gilia viscida
intro: Gilia viscida, commonly known as Sticky Gilia, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Polemoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as the ability to support immune function and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Gilia viscida are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. Furthermore, the bioactive compounds present in Gilia viscida are thought to be responsible for its potential to exhibit antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer properties.
